description: D* Lite shortest-path repair under start movement and directed edge-cost changes.

source.title: D* Lite
source.reuse: Algorithmic ideas only; clean-room contract and implementations.

input.vertex_ids: row-major grid cells from 0 through H*W-1
input.directed_arc_rule: simple directed arcs between orthogonally adjacent vertices only
input.event_rule: each event moves the start to any vertex and replaces one existing directed arc cost; no-op and repeated updates are allowed

output.meaning: sum over events t of t*(distance_code+1)*(next_code+1); distance_code is exact distance through 135 or 136 if unreachable, next_code is smallest shortest-path successor ID plus one, or zero at the goal/unreachable

algorithm_details.primary: Maintain D* Lite g/rhs values and a one-entry-per-inconsistent-vertex open set ordered by key1, key2, then vertex ID. Apply the Manhattan key modifier for start movement, update the changed arc tail, and run canonical overconsistent/underconsistent repair.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: After every event, recompute directed all-pairs shortest paths from scratch with Floyd-Warshall and select the smallest-ID optimal successor.
algorithm_details.primary_complexity: With R total queue removals, O(E+R*V+Q*E) time and O(V+E+Q) space for the bounded array-backed open set.
